dock.cursor: not v.showOnboarding and (v.mode == 2 or v.mode == 3) and v.slotIdx <= 4 and v.slotIdx or 0

scripts.refreshRecruitPresentation:
local v = ctx.v
local preview = api.actorPreview(v.candidateActorId, v.candidateLevel or 1)
local actorData = preview and preview.actorData or {}
v.candidatePortraitKey = actorData.portrait or v.portraitKey
v.candidateSpriteKey = actorData.smallBattler or v.portraitKey

v.candidateRoster = {
    {
        name = v.candidateName or "?",
        level = v.candidateLevel or 1,
        hp = v.candidateHp or 0,
        maxHp = v.candidateMaxHp or 1,
        spriteKey = v.candidateSpriteKey,
        portraitKey = v.candidatePortraitKey,
        atk = v.atk or 0,
        def = v.def or 0,
        mat = v.mat or 0,
        mdf = v.mdf or 0,
    }
}

local mpd = v.mpdDelta or 0
if mpd > 0 then
    v.upkeepText = "+" .. tostring(mpd) .. " shared MP drain per battle round."
elseif mpd < 0 then
    v.upkeepText = tostring(math.abs(mpd)) .. " less shared MP drain per battle round."
else
    v.upkeepText = "No additional shared MP drain."
end

local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
local isReserve = slotIdx > 4
local slot = isReserve and (slotIdx - 4) or slotIdx
local occupant = isReserve and api.reserve(slot) or api.party(slot)
if occupant and occupant.empty then occupant = nil end
local rosterName = isReserve and "RESERVE" or "ACTIVE"
v.destinationTitle = rosterName .. " SLOT " .. tostring(slot)
    .. ": " .. (occupant and occupant.name or "Empty")

if not occupant then
    v.destinationEffect = isReserve
        and "The candidate joins the reserve."
        or "The candidate joins the fielded party."
elseif not isReserve then
    local emptyReserve = nil
    for reserveSlot = 1, 4 do
        local reserveMember = api.reserve(reserveSlot)
        if not reserveMember or reserveMember.empty then
            emptyReserve = reserveSlot
            break
        end
    end
    if emptyReserve then
        v.destinationEffect = occupant.name .. " moves to Reserve slot "
            .. tostring(emptyReserve) .. "."
    else
        v.destinationEffect = occupant.name
            .. " moves to Town Storage if space is available."
    end
else
    v.destinationEffect = occupant.name
        .. " moves to Town Storage if space is available."
end

v.confirmText = (v.candidateName or "The candidate") .. " will take "
    .. rosterName .. " slot " .. tostring(slot) .. ".\n" .. v.destinationEffect
scripts.navigatePlacementUp:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode == 2 and (v.slotIdx or 1) <= 4 then
    v.slotIdx = (v.slotIdx or 1) + 4
end
scripts.navigatePlacementDown:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode == 2 and (v.slotIdx or 1) > 4 then
    v.slotIdx = v.slotIdx - 4
end
scripts.navigatePlacementLeft:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode == 2 then
    local reserve = (v.slotIdx or 1) > 4
    local slot = reserve and (v.slotIdx - 4) or (v.slotIdx or 1)
    slot = slot <= 1 and 4 or slot - 1
    v.slotIdx = slot + (reserve and 4 or 0)
end
scripts.navigatePlacementRight:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode == 2 then
    local reserve = (v.slotIdx or 1) > 4
    local slot = reserve and (v.slotIdx - 4) or (v.slotIdx or 1)
    slot = slot >= 4 and 1 or slot + 1
    v.slotIdx = slot + (reserve and 4 or 0)
end
